incident_report.forensic_audit: Philo was attempting to process a massive sharded library (~18,000 words across six volumes). Log tail indicates the system hit a 4.1 GB heap limit before termination. Artifacts were partially committed but not promoted to the trunk.

tasks.description: Verify integrity of sharded Genesis volumes in temporal node 2026/Q1/01/08/json/.
Propose technical strike to promote Genesis V1.25.0 volumes to Heartwood Trunk.
Seek Lead Partner authorization for trunk promotion and OOM mitigation protocol.

mitigation_proposal.short_term: Surgically promote the verified Genesis volumes to repos/diy-make/memory/public/json/trunk/.
mitigation_proposal.long_term: Implement memory-efficient ingestion for 'heartwood.py' to handle large sharded libraries without heap saturation.
